changelog_text:
- Added navball off edge directional indicator to the navball star marker feature
- fixed shennanigans so that each vessel/kitten remembers and saves it's correct star orientation target if being used
- changed the star orientation button to be a toggle which should when pressed again revert the vessel/kitten to their previously used orientation mode

listing.name: OhMyStars
listing.abstract: This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!
listing.description:
This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!

Features: 
- Constellation (Asterism) Lines between stars  
- Constellation Boundary lines (IAU defined) - Star informational window  
- Star names and informational window  
- Vehicle orientation mode to point towards stars
